## Working with Text
Download Villanova’s Mission Statement  
[Mission Statement](https://www1.villanova.edu/villanova/president/about_university/mission.html)  
```r
mission <- read_file("Villanova Mission Statement.txt")
```

---

## Tokenization
```r
mission %>% str_split(" ")
mission %>% str_split("\s+")
```
![Image placeholder]

---

## Tokenization II
```r
mission %>% str_split("\s+") %>% unlist()
mission %>% str_remove_all("[[:punct:]]") %>% str_split("\s+") %>% unlist() %>% str_to_lower()
```
![Image placeholder]

---

## Word Totals
```r
missionwords %>% count(words) %>% arrange(desc(n))
```
![Image placeholder]

---

## Stopwords
```r
library(tm)
stopwords("english")
```
![Image placeholder]

---

## Remove Stopwords
```r
missionwords %>% filter(words %in% stopwords("english") == F) %>% count(words) %>% arrange(desc(n))
```
![Image placeholder]

---

## Graph of Mission Statement Words
```r
missionwords %>% filter(words %in% stopwords("english") == F) %>% count(words) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% filter(n>=3) %>% ggplot() + geom_col(aes(words,n))
```
![Image placeholder]

---

## Wordcloud
```r
wordcloud(missionwords$words, min.freq=4, colors=1:4, random.order=F)
```
![Image placeholder]
